description: Ridgeline Plume turns dozens of series into one readable picture. Drop a category in Ridge (years, stations, products…), a position in X axis (day of year, month, hour) and a measure in Height: each value becomes a ridge, stacked and overlapping like a mountain range. FREE, NO WATERMARK - Classic ridgeline with adjustable overlap and smooth curves, sorted by any field - Color gradient along each ridge (e.g. temperature), per-ridge or solid colors - Two palettes (sequential and diverging), reverse palette, follow the report theme - Minimal (sparkline) mode for KPI tiles - Dynamic formatting: an fx button on every color and text, and a "Dynamic format" field to drive any Format setting with a DAX measure - Tooltips, cross-filtering, highlighting, context menu, drill-through, bookmarks, keyboard navigation, high contrast, English and French PREMIUM (★, additional purchase) - Ridge-by-ridge animation with play bar - Focus mode: double-click a ridge to open it as a classic chart with axes, reference curve, min–max band and colored anomalies - Comparison mode: overlay selected ridges on the same axes - Heatmap (horizontal or vertical) and perspective modes - Style card shared by every Plume visual: 10 preset styles (Neon, Press, Dark…), 16 more palettes and a theme JSON to apply your brand colors - Top N, mean curve, thresholds, cursor (halo and position line) and bubble annotations…
